title: Ordinary scalar extension of the tower unit counit trace
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and finite coefficient subfields of a fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and fix $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$ with $j$ open, $p$ proper, and $f=p\circ j$ a $k$-morphism smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the actual complete finite-Tor integral categories, completed pullback and tensor, and the specified compact-support/exceptional adjunctions of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix a ring system $S$, models $M$, a field-extension result $R$, and Stages $A_E$ for all finite coefficient fields as in [def-pur-tower-trace-comparison-data, det-sp-field-extension-towers]. Suppose all their unit orientations have the prescribed finite reductions. Then for every finite field $E$, $C_E(\tau_0(a^T_0))=\tau_E(a^T_E)$, where $0=\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\tau$ is counitTrace and $C_E$ is extendedTrace, with their specified inverse compact-support/twist and coefficient-unit comparisons.

source.place: Clause (2), scalar compatibility of purity and counits

proof.text: Use the integral purity and counit squares from the base inclusion to E. Transport the specified adjunctions by right-adjoint uniqueness; prescribed unit reductions identify the unit orientations by rank-one injectivity. Substitute the normalized ordinary coefficient multiplication and support comparison. Naturality moves the base orientation through the inverse support comparison; the purity and counit squares then cancel the twist and support comparisons, leaving the E counit trace. Finite freeness identifies the ordinary and strict scalar constructions.

theorem scalar_counit [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (S : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.RingSystem P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar
      P.field P.coefficients.different (f := j ≫ p))
    (M : FieldShriekSystem.Models P) (R : FieldExtensionTowers.Result P M j p d)
    (A : ∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P, Stage P j p d S M E (R.model E))
    (hA : ∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P,
      PrescribedUnitReductions P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)
        (orientation P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)))
    (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P) :
    extendedTrace P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)
        (counitTrace P j p d S M (base P) (R.model (base P)) (A (base P))
          (orientation P j p d S M (base P) (R.model (base P)) (A (base P)))) =
      counitTrace P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)
        (orientation P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E))
